answer: The voyage schedule is applied in tundra and fable publishes each instalment. A payout is split so that 50% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 851 identities would post 793 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
